name: timechimp
description: Connect to the TimeChimp MCP server (https://mcp.timechimp.com/mcp) to read hours, expenses, mileage, projects, customers, contracts, planning and availability.

interface.longDescription: Ask questions about your TimeChimp data: logged hours, expenses, mileage, projects and their budgets, customers, users and their contracts, teams, company holidays, the planning and remaining availability. Connects to the TimeChimp MCP server at https://mcp.timechimp.com/mcp and signs you in with your TimeChimp account (OAuth). Read-only: the plugin never creates, changes or deletes data.
defaultPrompt: How many hours did I log in TimeChimp this week, per project?
